$comment: Third-party assets vendored into public/ rather than installed from npm.
Nothing else tracks these: Dependabot and `npm outdated` only see
package.json, so without this file an upstream release — including a
security fix — would go unnoticed. `npm run check:vendor` compares each
entry against upstream. See issues #419 and #420.

assets.name: Leaflet
assets.notes: The asset here most likely to need a security update. Watch its releases.

assets.name: OpenDyslexic
assets.processing: Subset from the release OTFs to Latin + Latin-Extended with pyftsubset, converted to woff2. No glyph outlines altered, so the reserved font name may be retained.
assets.notes: OFL reserves the name 'OpenDyslexic'. If glyphs are ever edited the font must be renamed.

assets.name: Montserrat Alternates
assets.processing: Weight 700 only; latin and latin-ext subsets exactly as served by fonts.gstatic.com.
assets.notes: Version is the /vNN/ segment in the gstatic path, which Google bumps when the font is revised.
